items.t: Willoughby Half Duplexes for Sale real estate

faq.a: A fitted plan, not a guarantee: Jared helps the seller weigh timeline, home condition and goals, then applies thoughtful pricing, focused preparation and a launch schedule to keep the sale moving, with routes to a free home evaluation and a direct conversation. The page names no cash-offer program, no guaranteed timeline and no fee.
faq.q: What does this page actually offer a Langley seller who needs to sell fast?

faq.a: For a cash sale, no preparation, with the trade-off in price.
faq.q: Do I have to fix everything up before selling?

faq.a: The page states no fee or commission, and does not say when client status begins. Under the BC framework BCFSA publishes, a licensee must give consumers information about commissions and fees and must disclose at the outset of dealings whether they can represent you as a client — ask for both in the first conversation.
faq.q: What does this service cost, and does requesting it make me Jared's client?
Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.

faq.q: Does Jared work with both buyers and sellers?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, helps buyers and sellers across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361.
